# Deliberate references to symbols this cleanup series removed.
#
# Format: <path>:<symbol>, one per line. Only that symbol in that file is
# allowed; any other removed symbol in the same file still fails the check.
#
# Add an entry only when the reference is deliberate and the reason is written
# down at the reference itself. A reference which is merely harmless does not
# belong here -- delete it instead.

# The collaboration profile's managed-application set is the history of every
# application the profile has ever uninstalled, not a list of applications which
# still exist. Dropping an entry would strand it: rollback rebuilds "what the
# profile set" from this list and three-way merges it against live
# configuration, so a key an earlier profile run wrote but this list no longer
# mentions reads as an administrator's own choice and survives the restore
# permanently. The file says so at the list itself.
scripts/setup/manage_collaboration_profile.php:PhabricatorPasteApplication
scripts/setup/manage_collaboration_profile.php:PhabricatorDivinerApplication
scripts/setup/manage_collaboration_profile.php:PhabricatorOwnersApplication
scripts/setup/manage_collaboration_profile.php:PhabricatorAuditApplication
scripts/setup/manage_collaboration_profile.php:PhabricatorDifferentialApplication
scripts/setup/manage_collaboration_profile.php:PhabricatorHarbormasterApplication
scripts/setup/manage_collaboration_profile.php:PhabricatorDrydockApplication

# Translation tables are keyed by English source strings. "HarbormasterBuildable"
# appears inside the prose of a message, not as a reference to the class, and the
# key has to match the source string byte for byte to translate anything.
src/infrastructure/internationalization/translation/PhabricatorChineseTranslation.php:HarbormasterBuildable

# Application PHIDs are 'PHID-APPS-'.get_class($application), so these string
# literals are the values the stored rows carry. The classes are gone, so the
# patches cannot ask for them; each patch says so at the literal.
resources/sql/autopatches/20260911.paste.01.appemail.php:PhabricatorPasteApplication
resources/sql/autopatches/20260911.differential.01.appemail.php:PhabricatorDifferentialApplication

# "engineClassName" on a saved query is a stored string. This patch predates
# the removal and has to keep matching rows written while the class existed.
resources/sql/autopatches/20170811.differential.01.status.php:DifferentialRevisionSearchEngine

# A historical data migration which rewrites stored authorPHID values. The
# reason lives here rather than at the reference because .sql patches are
# applied verbatim and carry no comments anywhere in this tree.
resources/sql/autopatches/20140723.apprenamexaction.sql:PhabricatorHarbormasterApplication
